items.title: Recording a Conversation with a Veteran
items.alt: An older bearded man holds a small recorder across a round table from a woman taking notes.
items.description: A plain olive cap rests between the two speakers on the wooden tabletop. The man's blue shirt and gray vest contrast with the interviewer's green blouse, mustard trousers and spiral notebook.

items.title: A Homecoming Hug
items.alt: A red-haired woman in a tan field jacket lifts a smiling child in a red hoodie beside a packed duffel bag.
items.description: The child wraps both arms around the woman's shoulders as she holds him close. Her olive trousers and lace-up boots stand beside the soft canvas bag, keeping the reunion scene compact and complete.

items.title: Sharing a Community Meal
items.alt: Three older adults smile over bowls of soup at a wooden table, with bread and water glasses between them.
items.description: A man in a blue work shirt and olive cap sits opposite a rust-sweatered man, with a silver-haired woman in purple between them. The visible spoons and soup bowls capture a relaxed conversation over lunch.

items.title: Writing a Letter at a Wooden Desk
items.alt: A woman with long braids writes at a wooden desk beside an olive cap, envelopes and a pencil cup.
items.description: She leans over the paper in a textured green sweater, navy trousers and tan loafers. A single drawer and four slim legs keep the desk clearly defined beneath the scattered letter-writing supplies.

items.title: Packing Community Care Boxes
items.alt: Two older volunteers pack cardboard care boxes at a folding table covered with towels, toiletries and wrapped supplies.
items.description: The bearded man wears a denim shirt and plain olive cap, while the woman wears a red plaid shirt. Open boxes sit between neatly folded fabric and upright bottles, showing the practical packing activity clearly.

items.title: Repairing a Bicycle Together
items.alt: An older woman in denim overalls reaches for a wrench from a child beside a turquoise bicycle on a repair stand.
items.description: The woman kneels near the raised rear wheel as the smiling child extends the tool across the handlebars. A blue maintenance stand supports the small bicycle, leaving its frame and pedals easy to see.
